---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR),
    total_games = sum(G)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = total_hr)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total MLB Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
